---
applyTo: "docs/PROJECT.md,docs/HANDOFF.md,docs/tasks/**/*.md,src/**/*.tsx"
---

Read the product brief and selected feature acceptance examples before building a screen. Connect UI, typed IPC, persistence, and recoverable failure states in the same feature. For local documents, pass the loaded revision when saving and reload after a conflict. Record actual checks and the next concrete task in docs/HANDOFF.md. Never mark unfinished or unverified acceptance criteria complete.
